# @suluk/cost

> Cost as a contract facet: declare per-operation cost (incl. third-party usage), bubble it into the v4 doc/Scalar/tests, and meter the ACTUAL per-user cost at runtime (frontend action -> operation -> third-party). Display as-is. CANDIDATE tooling.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `formatMicroUsd`: Format micro-USD as a display string (we store raw integers; this is only for humans).
- `settlementOf`: The settlement declared on an operation's cost.
- `settlementAudit`: Audit that every PRICED operation names HOW it is settled, and that the named lever is coherent — the generic form of
toolfactory's "cost names a l...
- `impliedErrorStatuses`: The HTTP error statuses a request's FACETS imply (the generic form of toolfactory's errors-gate): a contract should
declare these responses.
- `settlementRollup`: A quick "how is this API monetized" tally — ops grouped by settlement method (+ priced-but-unsettled).
- `annotateCosts`: Annotate a v4 document in place-safe (returns a new doc): set x-suluk-cost on each named operation (incl. webhooks).
- `costOf`: Read the cost model declared on an operation (if any).
- `costAudit`: Cost-coverage audit: which operations have NOT declared what they cost — plus (C024) the background-cost
disciplines: a deferred cost that resolves...
- `costTable`: The declared costs across the document (paths + webhooks + jobs), for display (the cockpit/admin show this raw).
- `computeCost`: Compute the actual µ$ a request cost, from its declared model + the usage the handler reported.
- `eachOperation`: Every named operation in the document — path requests AND C018 webhooks (which are Requests carrying facets) —
as {path, name, req}.
- `eachJob`: Every background JOB (C025) on the document, as {path, name, job} — non-HTTP cron/queue work.
- `triggerOf`: The trigger an operation's cost declares (C024; default "synchronous").
- `isDeferredCost`: Does this cost accrue on a BACKGROUND event (a non-synchronous trigger) rather than the declaring op's own run?
- `costMeter`: Hono middleware: after the handler runs, record what the request cost (declared model + reported usage).
- `recordUsage`: A handler calls this to report MEASURED third-party usage for the current request (e.g. tokens used).
- `resolveEventExpression`: Resolve a C018 runtime-expression against a fired event.
- `attributePrincipal`: Resolve the principal charged for a fired event per the model's attribution strategy.
- `eventCostEvent`: Build the CostEvent for a FIRED background event — pure.
- `recordEventCost`: Record a fired event's cost into a sink, deduped by its `dedupeKey` against `seen` (so at-least-once delivery
can't double-charge).
- `reconciledAmount`: Resolve the ACTUAL charged amount (in µ$) from the event when the model is `payload-reconciled` (C026), else
undefined.
- `summarize`
- `principalCost`: What ONE principal cost you (the question that lets you price them) — and the trace by operation + action.
- `MemoryCostSink`: A simple in-memory sink (for the demo / tests). Production swaps in D1, a queue, etc.
- `UNATTRIBUTED`: The principal sentinel for a background cost that resolved to NO principal — billed to nobody, but never silent.
- `COST_EXT`

## Optional

### Types

- `CostBasis`: The cost model — what an operation declares it costs you, and what a single request actually cost.
- `CostComponent`: `@suluk/cost` — cost as a contract facet + runtime metering.
- `CostModel`: `@suluk/cost` — cost as a contract facet + runtime metering.
- `UsageReport`: A measured usage report for one variable component during a request (e.g. {source:"openai", units: 1350}).
- `CostEvent`: What a single request actually cost — the rawest record, attributed all the way down.
- `CostTrigger`: WHEN/WHAT fires a cost (C024) — a STATIC, locally-decidable enum (the same KIND as CostBasis).
- `CostAttribution`: WHO is charged when a third party fires the event with no live session (C024) — a declared STRATEGY the runtime
resolves a concrete principal from,...
- `ReconciliationBasis`: Whether a cost's amount is a declared guess or read from the event payload at runtime (C026).
- `SettlementMethod`: HOW a declared cost is RECOVERED from the user (C044).
- `CostSettlement`: `@suluk/cost` — cost as a contract facet + runtime metering.
- `SettlementFinding`
- `SettlementSeverity`
- `SettlementRollup`
- `CostFinding`
- `CostRow`
- `CostSink`
- `EventCostInput`
- `CostSummary`
